PC 0 = Live knobs (preset off). PC 1–3 = onboard presets (red/green/blue LED). PC 4–20 = MIDI-only presets (cyan); empty slots do nothing. Footswitches still cycle 1–3 when a MIDI preset is active.

PC 0 = Live knobs (preset off). PC 1–3 = onboard (red/green/blue). PC 4–20 = MIDI-only (light blue); empty slots do nothing. PC 126 = pedal Off. PC 127 = pedal On (no preset). Any PC 0–20 turns the pedal On. Save MIDI presets: hold PRESET 3s (LED white), then send PC 4–20. PC 21–125 unused.
PC 0 = Live knobs (preset off). PC 1–3 = onboard (red/green/blue). PC 4–20 = MIDI-only (light blue); empty slots do nothing. Save MIDI presets: hold both footswitches 3s, then send PC 4–20.

PC 1 = preset 1 (Live Knobs, red). PC 2–6 = onboard (green/blue/yellow/cyan/purple). PC 7–20 = MIDI-only (white bypass LEDs); empty slots do nothing. Footswitches return to presets 1–6 when a MIDI preset is active.

Aeros opens songs using CC0 MSB plus PC, in that order. LSB CC32 is not relevant for Aeros song select. The song must first be opened manually and saved with MIDI Song Select enabled to assign the MSB/PC combination.

Default song select uses Bank Select MSB CC0, LSB CC32, and PC. MSB selects the bank, LSB selects the folder within the bank, and PC selects the song within the current folder. If only PC is sent, it opens the corresponding song in the current folder.
